basic_info.notes: Many of the activities have only one repetititon, therefore with the increase in path percentage more activities are added to the absolute frequency of the cases. In the case of primary dependency we observe a loop which is also another indication for a possible bottleneck in the process map

domain_context.process_information: Records containing relating to changes provided by the Rabobank Group ICT

academic_context.reference: Rabobank: A Process Mining Case Study BPI Challenge 2014 Report

data_characteristics.performance_issues_notes: There were 5 other activities noted that can be a potential cause for performance issues. However due to having the max absolute frequency and repetitions out of them all this dependency has been chosen as the primary.

path_observation.notes_for_path_reduction: The path detail was too complex a lot. The intention was not to go below 50% for any of the datasets therefore the reduction was held at 50% even when still a complex, spaghetti behavior between the activities can be displayed.

basic_info.notes:
All cases have only one recorded case, therefore for the mean duration Top 5 variants has been chosen in an ascending order. For the case coverage the variants with most events has been chosen. 
Additonally the resource class has no indication with NONE having 100% relative frequency, it is not possible to make concrete assumptions about resources even though it is available as an attribute. 
In the class for Resource only statement is 'NONE' with 100% frequency

domain_context.process_information: Bank Transaction Process Modeling

academic_context.reference: On the Move to Meaningful Internet Systems: OTM 2014 Conferences

data_characteristics.performance_issues_notes: Max Repetition shows three loops: between RAP-CAPR-URAP; SHRRPC-AHRRPC-MHRRPC-FHRRPC-RHRRPC and SRPP-RBPC-RIBPC-REPC-FRPP-REPP.Maximal duration is always 60 minutes: No indication for issues.

path_observation.notes_for_path_reduction: The absolute frequency is consistent for the pathways between the activities SRPP, RIBPC, REPP, RBPC, REPC, FRPP.  The process map changes slightly with the increase in details of paths from 60% to 80%, however it can be said that it displays a consistent behavior.

basic_info.notes: The frequency of resource is 73.12% for blank and has been noted at hightest with 1.53% frequency, so there is a missing identifier.
